name: The Glottkin
canonNotes: Three Norscan-born brothers, Ethrac the sorcerer, Otto the scythe-wielder and Ghurk the brutish, whose dying mother was saved by Nurgle's blessing at their birth.
Their parents, peaceful Empire folk, were killed by a reprisal force from Nordland; the brothers embraced Nurgle and now seek vengeance on the Empire.
voiceNotes: Three voices in one letter: Ethrac clever and cold, Otto rustic and grimly jovial, Ghurk crude; they bicker yet act as one.
Talk of blessings, rot and harvest; hatred for Nordland and the Empire.
ttsInstructions: A heavy, gurgling, jovially menacing voice.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
